title: University of Strathclyde
description: The University of Strathclyde's official branding guidelines define the main corporate colour navy (#002B5C) and the supporting corporate colour grey (#A7A9AC), the faculty colours Engineering (#0078AE), Humanities & Social Sciences (#F47B20), Science (#5D9732) and Strathclyde Business School (#EE3224), and the digital call-to-action colour (#018489).
